title: Ariadne state-fixture predicate v1
description: The predicate body of an in-toto Statement whose predicateType is https://ariadne.wildcat.finance/state-fixture/v1. The verifier in plugins/ariadne enforces this shape plus the gates described in docs/state-fixture.md; a schema cannot express those gates, which is why both ship. In particular no schema can express the rule this type exists for: a proof_backed count above zero is refused without a state_root to have proved it against.

chain.description: The pin: which chain, which height, which of the blocks at that height. state_root is not in this object's required list, because a capture that proved nothing against the trie needs none. It becomes required as soon as a proof_backed count is above zero, which the allOf/if/then at the bottom of this schema expresses and the verifier enforces.

chain_id.description: An integer, not the hex quantity string a Lazarus manifest writes. The wire form does not compare as a number.

block_number.description: An integer. A hex quantity string orders as text, so "0xc7da16" would sort below "0x2".

block_hash.description: A 32-byte hash, 0x-prefixed and lowercase. Lazarus writes block hashes in either case; this type accepts only lowercase, because two spellings of one value compare unequal and a statement is a thing other implementations compare. The all-zero value is refused: it matches the shape and identifies nothing.

state_root.description: The state root a proof-backed record was checked against. A 32-byte hash, 0x-prefixed and lowercase. Required whenever proof_backed is above zero. The all-zero value is refused by the verifier: it matches the pattern and identifies nothing.

capture.description: The tool that produced the fixture. A fixture is only as reproducible as the thing that wrote it.

command.description: The argv that ran, word by word. Not a shell string.

parameters_digest.description: Algorithm to lowercase hex digest. At least one of sha256, sha384 or sha512.

fixture_subjects.description: One entry per component file. Every digest must also be a subject of the statement, which the verifier checks and a schema cannot.

path.description: Fixture-relative. The pattern refuses a leading slash, a backslash, an empty segment and any .. segment, so a reader resolving it against the fixture stays inside it. The verifier refuses the same shapes; an earlier draft of this schema left the rule to the verifier alone and accepted paths it went on to reject.

digest.description: Algorithm to lowercase hex digest. At least one of sha256, sha384 or sha512.

evidence.description: The three evidence classes, spelled as Lazarus spells them in its manifest schema. All three are required: a class left out reads as nothing of that kind having been captured rather than as nobody having said.

proof_backed.description: Checked against the pinned block's state root. A count above zero with no state_root is refused by the verifier.

header_bound.description: Tied to the captured header without a trie proof.

recorded_rpc.description: A response an endpoint gave, recorded and not proved. Never describe one of these as proof-backed.

replay.description: Both fields are required and both must be false. The verifier enforces the value; a schema can only require the key.

reaches_network.description: A replay that falls back to an endpoint is not a fixture, and the endpoint is the thing a fixture exists to outlive.

canonical_chain_claim.description: A block hash and a state root pin a block, not its place in a chain nothing here re-derived.

deltas.description: The comparison against an earlier capture of the same block. A first capture carries a null baseline and a reason.

name.description: A side that is there has to identify something. Every verifier here refuses a name that is absent or only whitespace, and a schema accepting one publishes a shape the tool will not take.

digest.description: Algorithm to lowercase hex digest. At least one of sha256, sha384 or sha512.

name.description: A side that is there has to identify something. Every verifier here refuses a name that is absent or only whitespace, and a schema accepting one publishes a shape the tool will not take.

digest.description: Algorithm to lowercase hex digest. At least one of sha256, sha384 or sha512.

reason.description: Required when baseline is null. A first capture says why there is nothing to compare against.

subject.description: Algorithm to lowercase hex digest. At least one of sha256, sha384 or sha512.

output_digest.description: Algorithm to lowercase hex digest. At least one of sha256, sha384 or sha512.

allOf.$comment: A proof-backed count above zero needs a state root to have been proved against. Nothing else in this schema depends on a value elsewhere in the document.
